description: She wears a floor-length muted plum-purple patterned overdress with a fitted bodice, low square neckline and elbow-length sleeves, over a cream textured underdress. Narrow gold woven borders edge the neckline, sleeves, front and hem. A decorated waist belt has a circular patterned buckle and a long flat hanging end. A matching purple drape rests along both arms and falls at the sides with fine gold edging. Small earrings and a ring provide restrained jewelry. Brown gold-decorated closed shoes show beneath the hem. Upper chest is exposed while opaque layered cloth covers the bust, abdomen, hips and pelvis. No headgear or armor appears; fibers remain visually uncertain.
